product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides AI-powered eDiscovery software that helps law firms, corporate legal teams, government agencies and legal service providers collect, process, review and analyze evidence for litigation and investigations.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the site navigation; /pricing displays a demo-request form rather than plans.

employee_band.notes: The 2026 Inc. profile reports 201–500 employees; Reveal’s own About page instead says 500+, so public sources disagree.

founded_year.notes: The founding/incorporation year is 2008; Reveal’s history dates its first product launch to January 2009.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is primarily legal-industry commentary and product marketing; two engineer-authored product-build posts were not established.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current board lists a full-stack software engineer but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Reveal engineers publicly describe using Amazon Comprehend for PII detection/redaction in Reveal’s Logikcull. This does not establish the LLM provider behind Ask or aji.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names these under Compliance. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a formal certification. A HIPAA report is listed, but no HIPAA certification is asserted.

last_funding.notes: Latest explicitly identified capital-investment round in the company history: January 2021, $250M. The contemporaneous investor announcement says over $200M. K1 also funded the 2023 acquisitions, but that announcement does not separately disclose a financing-round amount; its more-than-$1B figure describes the transactions.

raised_18mo.notes: No fundraising announcement was found for 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09; the identified 2021 investment and 2023 acquisition financing both predate the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive, II posting is listed on the careers board.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-09-22, Reveal announced an immediately available unified corporate eDiscovery suite combining Reveal Hold, Onna and Logikcull.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The verified CEO change was announced on 2025-10-14, before the 2025-11-09 window. No complete dated leadership roster was available to establish a negative for the requested period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Account Executive posting names these as sales tools and explicitly calls Salesforce its CRM.
